items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I left Perez then and went with Roy and Cozy and Sal Yaged at the Metropole. I stayed over there for two years, see.

ctx.x: Well, how did -- I mean now, we talked about, like, the rhythm sections, Basie and McShann, and we haven't said too much about Charlie Parker and bebop. Well now, how did Perez feel about the new type of rhythm sections?

Well, both he and Ben Webster were -- and Roy were, I'd say, the only people who were really vocal. Well, the other guys would say, well, man, there's something new. I ain't going to put it down, I might have to go with it. Ben Webster
